title: Actual stalk coordinates and fineness inside a fine fan chart
statement: Let $X$ be a sheafed space of commutative monoids, $c:X|_V\simeq S(A)$ a chart with $A$ fine, and $z\in V$, with conventions [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup] and canonical-section pullback [lem-trf-affine-fan-hom-universal]. Put $\mathfrak p=c(z)$ and $P=\mathcal P_{X,z}$. Then $P$ is fine and there exists a monoid equivalence $e:P\simeq A_{\mathfrak p}/A_{\mathfrak p}^{\times}$ which sends the actual germ at $z$ of the pullback through $c$ of every canonical section $a\in A$ to the class of the canonical numerator $a$. The localization is the specified faceLocalization submonoid in the canonical group completion, not an arbitrary isomorphic localization.

source.place: Expose VIII, 3.1.2--3.1.4, printed p.98, and Remark 3.1.10(ii), printed pp.99--100; canonical sharpening and stalk coordinates used in proof of 3.3.15, printed p.109.

proof.text: Transport the actual stalk through the open restriction and the chart isomorphism using Mathlib PresheafedSpace.restrictStalkIso and stalkIso. Apply [lem-trf-affine-fan-localization-sections] at the resulting prime. Naturality of germs under restriction and under the chart map, together with its numerator and germ formulas, gives exactly the specified numerator equality.

source.place: Expose VIII, 3.1.2--3.1.4, printed p.98, and Remark 3.1.10(ii), printed pp.99--100; canonical sharpening and stalk coordinates used in proof of 3.3.15, printed p.109.

proof.text: Choose a finite generating tuple of A. By [lem-trf-monoid-prime-minimal-neighborhood], the prime complement localization is localization at the product s of the generators outside the prime. It is generated by the original tuple and s inverse: write every fraction as a numerator times a nonnegative power of that inverse. Its embedding as a submonoid of the group completion proves integrality.

source.place: Expose VIII, 3.1.2--3.1.4, printed p.98, and Remark 3.1.10(ii), printed pp.99--100; canonical sharpening and stalk coordinates used in proof of 3.3.15, printed p.109.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-integral-sharpening-group-exactness] to this integral localization. Its sharpening is integral and the images of the finite generating list generate it. Transport finite generation and injectivity into group completion across the stalk equivalence from Step 1. This proves fineness of the actual stalk.

lean.statement:
theorem fineFan_chart_stalk_coordinates (X : SheafedSpace CommMonCat.{u})
    (c : Chart X) (z : X) (hc : z ∈ c.openSet) :
    IsFine (stalk X.presheaf z) ∧
    ∃ e : stalk X.presheaf z ≃*
        Associates (Algebra.faceLocalization c.monoid
          (Submonoid.closure {b | b ∉ (c.iso.hom.hom.base ⟨z, hc⟩).carrier})),
      ∀ b : c.monoid,
        ∃ q : Algebra.faceLocalization c.monoid
            (Submonoid.closure {b | b ∉ (c.iso.hom.hom.base ⟨z, hc⟩).carrier}),
          q.val = Algebra.GrothendieckGroup.of b ∧
          e (germ X.presheaf c.openSet z hc
            ((X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (Opens.isOpenEmbedding_obj_top c.openSet).symm).op)
              (affinePullback c.iso.hom b))) = Associates.mk q
